cases.name: Sonja Kaye Blair-Adams
cases.about: She had been unidentified as "Mountain Jane Doe" for 47 years and had strawberry blonde hair. Sonja was exhumed in November 2015 and positively identified in September 2016.
cases.narrative: Her nude, decomposing body had multiple stab wounds to the chest and was found by a man who was picking wildflowers for his wife. The coroners estimated she had been deceased for 2-3 weeks.
